'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Trevin Tyson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Trevin Tyson]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' TRM
* '''Username:''' Tyson
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
